#Economics #Debt #USPol

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (liquidity management) with WHO (taxpayers bearing inflation costs). It's a classic smoke-and-mirrors deflection away from runaway congressional spending.

Social Physics Analysis:
Washington maintains power through debt expansion while projecting fiscal stability, forcing future citizens to bear the catastrophic cost of unaddressed structural deficits.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation into Destruction.
The gap between political spin and bond market reality plots a direct collision with currency debasement and insolvency.

The Unavoidable Truth: Investors will not fund limitless deficits indefinitely without demanding punishing risk premiums.

The Unavoidable Lie: Administrative grant cuts can outgrow a $40 trillion debt burden.
